verdict.rationale: Gusto's API supports agent-driven payroll actions (an official MCP server lets AI tools interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API [gusto-docs-6/34], and a preview endpoint exists for contractor payments that validates inputs and surfaces 'submission_blockers' for review [gusto-docs-27, gusto-docs-10]), which is functionally close to an anomaly-surfacing preview. However, there is no documented preview/anomaly-check endpoint for standard employee (W2) payroll runs before approval—only creation (POST) and retrieval (GET unprocessed) endpoints are shown. Missing for 10: an explicit payroll preview/anomaly-detection API for regular/off-cycle W2 runs, and any evidence of an agent workflow that surfaces anomalies pre-approval rather than just blockers for contractors.
